## Overall Comments
- The Makefile currently never narrows `OPERATORS` when `OPERATOR` is provided (e.g. `make test OPERATOR=keystone` still iterates over all operators), which diverges from the docs and wastes CI time; consider conditionally setting `OPERATORS := $(OPERATOR)` when `OPERATOR` is non-empty so the matrix jobs truly scope to a single operator.
- In `test-integration`, `KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS` is set using `$(SETUP_ENVTEST)` but the CI job installs `setup-envtest` into `$GOBIN` without exporting that path for local runs; it may be worth either documenting this requirement or wiring `$(SETUP_ENVTEST)` to an absolute path derived from `go env GOPATH` to make local invocation more reliable.

## Inline Code Comments
- .github/workflows/ci.yaml:269: **suggestion (testing):** The Helm deploy step assumes the chart’s `image.repository` matches the locally built image, which may not always hold.

Right now the chart is installed with only `image.tag=dev` and `image.pullPolicy=Never` set, so it implicitly depends on `image.repository` defaulting to `ghcr.io/c5c3/keystone-operator`. If that default ever changes, these E2E tests could start using a remote image instead of the one built and loaded into kind. To avoid this, explicitly set `image.repository` to `${{ env.IMAGE_PREFIX }}/${{ matrix.operator }}-operator` in the Helm install command so the tests always run against the locally built image.

```suggestion
      - name: Deploy operator
        run: |
          helm install ${{ matrix.operator }}-operator \
            operators/${{ matrix.operator }}/helm/${{ matrix.operator }}-operator/ \
            --set image.repository=${{ env.IMAGE_PREFIX }}/${{ matrix.operator }}-operator \
            --set image.tag=dev \
            --set image.pullPolicy=Never \
            --wait --timeout 120s
```

✅ Addressed in 2e76e0b9b11087de8f3a39b960cfdfb0fa5e8379: The Helm install command now explicitly sets `image.repository` to `${{ env.IMAGE_PREFIX }}/${{ matrix.operator }}-operator`, ensuring the E2E tests use the locally built image rather than relying on the chart default.
